title: Private screenshot without public source
source_basis: No public source URL is available for independent record review.
methodological_point: Private screenshots are excluded unless independently supported by public source material.
public_claim_limit: This example does not describe a published event record or external review outcome.

title: Single public source with limited details
source_basis: One public source supports the core record, but date precision and institutional response detail are limited.
methodological_point: A record can be included while confidence remains below High because source support is limited.
public_claim_limit: This example must not be used as proof of prevalence, severity, intent, or institutional fault.

title: Public response date with limited response text
source_basis: The public source supports a response date and procedural posture, but not a complete independent response assessment.
methodological_point: Limited response notes should be visible as words while avoiding claims that the response was evaluated.
public_claim_limit: This example must not be used to claim that Campus Evidence Lab judged the institution's completed response.

title: Correction request with public source support
source_basis: A public government case summary identifies a field that could correct or narrow an event record.
methodological_point: Corrections should identify the record field, requested change, and public source basis before publication.
public_claim_limit: This example does not mean the correction is accepted until the public review workflow records a decision.

title: Source URL requires follow-up
source_basis: The record was source-backed, but the latest live audit indicates the source URL may need replacement or archival context.
methodological_point: Source-audit risk is a maintenance signal and should not be converted into a claim about record truth.
public_claim_limit: This example must not be used to imply that the event did or did not occur.

title: Broad affected-community label needs review
source_basis: The public source supports a broad sex or gender-related label but does not safely support a narrower community label.
methodological_point: Broad labels should remain visible for review and should be narrowed only when public source text supports narrowing.
public_claim_limit: This example must not be used to infer motive, individual experience, or group-specific prevalence.
